request: Analyze GSE126962 for PMID 31006592 (Time of Exercise Specifies the Impact on Muscle Metabolic Pathways and Systemic Energy Homeostasis.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk total RNA-seq (Ribo-Zero), mouse gastrocnemius, HiSeq 2500 PE100
final.primary_estimand: Effect of one 1-h treadmill exercise bout versus sham exercise (stationary treadmill) on gastrocnemius gene expression, separately for exercise in the early rest phase (ZT3) and the early active phase (ZT15), at 0, 4, 8, 12, 16 and 20 h after exercise; and whether the exercise effect differs between the two times of day
final.inclusion: Male C57BL/6J, 10-11 weeks; n=5-6 per phase x treatment x time cell; one mouse per sample (terminal harvest)
planned_contrasts: Exercise vs sedentary within the rest phase at each of 6 post-exercise times (abstract; GEO overall design)
Exercise vs sedentary within the active phase at each of 6 post-exercise times (abstract; GEO overall design)
Time-of-day dependence of the exercise response (abstract: 'distinct responses ... in either the early rest phase or the early active phase')
final.paper_method: edgeR on featureCounts counts after filtering to CPM > 2 in >= 34 samples (GEO data_processing); circadian/oscillation analysis also used (abstract: 'metabolic oscillations'), method not stated in the abstract
final.paper_results: Abstract: glycolytic activation specific to active-phase exercise; HIF1a selectively activated in a time-dependent manner; no DEG counts and no named genes other than HIF1a in the abstract

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: No full text available; the study map rests on the PubMed abstract and the GEO series/sample records (overall design, treatment protocol, data_processing). The paper's DE threshold and DEG counts are not in the abstract.
paper_reconstruction.locator: PubMed abstract; GEO GSE126962 overall_design; GSM data_processing

checks: 140 GSM per-sample CPM files belong to GSE126962 (identical to the members of GSE126962_RAW.tar)
3 deposited files (GSM3618934/35/36) contain corrupted bytes inside valid gzip; excluded from the merged matrix

ownership.reasoning: GEO series links PMID 31006592. Matrix merged from the series' own per-sample files by prep_GSE126962.py (GEO FTP returned 403 at first; the files were fetched through the GEO download endpoint and later matched byte-for-byte against GSE126962_RAW.tar).

exclude_samples.GSM3618934: deposited GSM3618934_049.txt.gz is corrupted (non-ASCII bytes inside gene IDs and values; identical in RAW.tar)

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are GSM ids (set by the prep script), exact match on the metadata index. hpe = hours after exercise: zt is the clock time at harvest; exercise ended at ZT4 (rest) or ZT16 (active), so harvest ZT minus 4 (rest) or minus 16 (active), mod 24 (GEO treatment protocol: harvest 0-20 h after exercise).

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: 'Text file ... with gene counts in units of count per million (CPM)'; filtered to 11461 genes with CPM > 2 in >= 34 samples. Profile: integer fraction 0.0002, non-negative, max 4.5e5. The paper analysed raw counts with edgeR; raw counts were not deposited.

final.analysis_type: multi-factor (treatment x phase x time), one model on all samples, cell means
final.formula: ~ 0 + C(cell)  (cell = trt x phase x hpe, 24 cells)
final.contrasts: 12 planned simple effects EX vs SED within each phase x hpe; all other analyzable comparisons (trt:phase interactions per hpe, time and phase effects) exploratory

candidates.value: zt (harvest clock time) as the time factor
candidates.reason_rejected: Same 24 cells, but trt:phase interactions at equal ZT would compare different times since exercise; hpe gives interpretable time-of-day interactions at equal post-exercise time

candidates.value: pool all time points into EX vs SED per phase
candidates.reason_rejected: The design is a time course with a sham control at every time point; pooling discards the time structure the paper studies

design.reasoning: Each phase has its own sham group at every harvest time (GEO treatment protocol), so the exercise effect is identified within phase x time. One limma model on all 137 samples shares variance across cells.

covariance.reasoning: Every sample is a different mouse (terminal harvest), so there is no repeated-measure unit. No batch or lane information in GEO. zt is a deterministic function of phase x hpe and is part of the cell, not a covariate.

final.method: limma (moderated t, joint cell-means model) on log2(CPM+1)

paper_route.reason: only CPM values were deposited in GEO; raw counts would require reprocessing SRA SRP186637 (140 PE100 libraries), out of scope

deviations: limma on log2(CPM+1) instead of edgeR on counts
3 samples with corrupted deposited files excluded
gene filter is the authors' (CPM > 2 in >= 34 samples, applied before deposit); no further filtering

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: linear normalized expression -> log2(x+1) then limma. CPM must not be rounded into counts.

final.deviation_note: Paper threshold not stated in the abstract (no full text). Workflow default BH padj < 0.05, no fold-change rule; audit adds |log2FC| > log2(1.5) for reference only.

threshold.reasoning: Abstract only; GEO data_processing names edgeR but no cutoff.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the PubMed abstract and GEO records only; no DEG counts are available to compare
limma on log2(CPM+1) instead of the paper's edgeR on counts
3 rest-phase h0 samples (EX rep3, SED rep3, EX rep4) excluded for corrupted deposited files; rest h0 has EX n=4, SED n=5

study.reasoning: Paper route blocked (no counts deposited); the analysis keeps the paper's estimand. Hif1a (ENSMUSG00000021109) is the only gene named in the abstract (as HIF1a, a protein-level activation claim).

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One limma cell-means model on all samples; the 12 planned EX vs SED simple effects are primary, every other analyzable comparison (including trt:phase interactions per hpe, the time-of-day question) is exploratory

enrichment.reasoning: abstract: glycolysis/HIF1a (Hallmark GLYCOLYSIS, HYPOXIA) after active-phase exercise
